experiment: All-layer native activity and estimated MOLT contribution ablation screen for child -> CH
activity_scope: All 2480 gate encoders at all 36 layers, all processed native tokens of ten exact prior prompts.
causal_scope: Exhaust all positive-gate MOLTs at the two primary sites in the uppercase child task; individual feature and site ablations. Other positions are activity-only.
intervention: Native MLP output minus gate * ((standardized prenorm input @ V) @ U) * output_std, accumulated FP32 and cast once to native BF16. Other MLP positions unchanged. Native attention unfrozen. Estimated component subtraction, not exact MOLT-only model.
metric: Correct-token CH log probability and log odds against the full other-token distribution; CH-vs-native-runnerup CI logit gap; greedy answer and output.
selection: All gate-active features at either of the two sites, without label or gate amplitude filtering. Rank helpful effects by baseline log odds minus ablated log odds, separately per site.
controls: Unhooked baseline; read-only replay; zero-strength and inactive-feature controls; all-source-at-one-layer and all-final-at-one-layer native MLP-output-zero controls; top findings rerun and evaluated on other spellings and templates. No conclusions from failed child probe.
confirmation: Up to eight strongest positive single-feature effects, both sites represented when positive; evaluate upper/lower baseline cases and new child prompts with different demonstration words, and non-CH cider/table controls. Group tests if no single-feature flip, selected after first-pass outcomes and labeled exploratory.
resources: Reuse retained SPAR instance 56698356, no rental or lifecycle action.
